title: Post-write direct neural-confidence audit using reserved charged physical experience at matched evaluator coverage

Focused/G29 Ubuntu/Windows PASS; mandatory inherited regression running. Do not retroactively change.

question: Can a source-blind physical post-write reliability audit reduce confident errors on untrained physics without merely refusing to answer more questions, using exactly the same real physical evidence, learned neural weights, and matched inference coverage as fixed-confidence and random-action controls?

source.physics: Four each shuffled parity, 3-way AND and mixed coupled/negated action dynamics, four separate 4-input parity challenge worlds. Source function families overlap WSP72, not open-world transfer.
source.physical: ONE no-reset, physically continuous 224-action trajectory per world. Phase A 96 actions trains two WSP70 numerical teachers (residual and random hidden-feature selectors) at their 48/96 growth checkpoints. Phase B next 96 actions writes WSP72 committee-selected dreams into an identical durable neural readout. Phase C last 32 real paid physical action/consequence observations are STRICTLY reserved for post-write auditing/calibration, never used to edit teacher or durable neural weights. Same public action policy, all controls have access to exactly the same C source-label information for calibration. No physical reset, arbitrary source queries, hidden source access or source import into model/calibrators.
source.tests: After ALL training and post-write audit: 12×64=768 primary evaluator-only state/action physical truth, 12×32=384 heldout 2-action compositions, 4×64=256 quartic negative physical truth. Genuine physically uncharged pair defined across entire A+B+C physical 224-action stream.
source.information: The C labels calibrate only source-blind safety decision, not neural weights. Selection may use C evidence, not test oracle labels or identities of quartic families. The no-C baseline is a diagnostic with fewer real-information inputs and not a fair superiority control.

frozen_candidate.base: Use unmodified WSP72 committee dream selector and WSP71 DurableNeuralWeights with 96 charged A primary+secondary teacher observations, 96 B student physical observations and k<=32 accepted synthetic dreams, retaining original 0.27 minimum output margin, inverse-covariance leverage<=2.0, ridge lambda=0.5, source-independent 224 action-conditioned conjunction source-biased dictionary. Both controls share EXACT same student numeric weights; no training differences for primary confidence comparison.
frozen_candidate.postwrite_audit: For each of four public action channels on the 32 independent C charged consequences, count baseline student confident physical predictions and errors. Action channel is ACCEPTED if it has >=3 confidently predicted C examples and EXACTLY 0 confidently wrong on those examples; otherwise reject all confident predictions for that action. This is deliberately harsh and may hurt coverage/retention. Never use source/private physics family in the gate.
frozen_candidate.ranking: For each model raw numeric prediction at public state/action, compute base confidence score = min_{4 bits}|raw_bit-0.5| - 0.02 * posterior_leverage. The unmodified baseline predictor must pass original 0.27+leverage<=2 to be a candidate. Gate overrides to abstention on untrusted action channels. Reuse the same original fixed numeric weights for all score variants.
frozen_candidate.matched_coverage: In the evaluator, after model and C gate are frozen, for each world separately compute m=number of primary-gate accepted predictions among the complete 64 **PUBLIC** test input/action identities. Construct two source-blind 64-context equal-coverage selections, each using only public input identities and the frozen base numeric confidence score or seeded hash (not evaluator truth). Baseline picks highest scored m inputs among baseline-confident ones (cannot pick more than baseline would predict), breaking ties by public lexicographic state/action. Random picks m baseline-confident contexts by seeded hash. Count correct/wrong on EXACT m predictions each. This is an offline coverage-matched DIAGNOSTIC involving unlabeled evaluation inputs, not deployable adaptive thresholding and not evidence of label-independent distributional calibration.
frozen_candidate.precommit_stats: Predict C outcomes using the frozen already trained durable neural student. Separate C calibration costs and overfit warning from true heldout evaluation. Do not train a learned cut-off from any evaluator truth.

If m=0, matched controls also m=0; no fake error reduction. Strict primary coverage and absolute correctness gates prevent pass solely via abstention.
Student weight matrices are IDENTICAL for gate, score and random controls; no new weight writes after Phase B. WSP72 SCIENCE negative remains frozen.

Phase C is extra charged real physics compared with WSP72. All serious fair controls get same Phase C C-observation access or same per-world m and numeric weights. C source distribution same as training world; this is not OOD-shift detection measured before any new-world action, and may not generalize to unseen mechanism shifts.
limits: Per-world evaluator uses 64 public input identities (without truth) to make matched-coverage selections; diagnostic only, not a deployable threshold selection.
Strict postwrite action-channel abstention may concentrate errors in still-trusted actions, and action-calibration C is only 32 samples; no formal confidence guarantee.
Four-bit deterministic synthetic world and source-aligned signed conjunction grammar, no AGI, language, open-world physics, long-horizon transfer or independent scientific acceptance.
Real Phase C costs 32 additional physically charged actions/world beyond WSP72; it MUST be counted. A positive result does not prove sample efficiency of the full learning pipeline.
